name: 13897-longprefill-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (SM90), one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, one process, no NCCL, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: MoE decoder (DeepseekV2ForCausalLM), 27 layers, bf16, ~15.7B total / ~2.4B activated (~31 GB of weights); the full shape is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10% / cooldown 10%, bounded at 60 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, every request identical: 28000 prompt tokens in, 64 out, min == max on both. Sent in `plain` form -- the backend default renders through a chat template this engine's tokenizer wrapper cannot apply -- and it re-encodes to exactly 28000 tokens on this checkpoint's tokenizer. Sampling is greedy (temperature 0.0) and ignore_eos fixes the output at 64 tokens; seed 13897.
purpose: A document-analysis assistant reading 28,000-token briefs one at a time, with short replies, on a single GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: e642ec962cf2283f9aa44492727e6efc17a32129 (v0.7.3-268-ge642ec962cf22), a source
# checkout, so the interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
#
# FORMAT: every key here must be top-level and every value must fit on ONE line; an indented
# continuation line is skipped by the flat reader and the key is silently dropped.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 32768
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
enable-prefix-caching: false
